product_one_liner.value: Karbon is a collaborative practice-management platform for accounting firms that brings teams, clients, workflows, communications, systems, and data together in one place.

employee_band.notes: The company profile accompanying the job posting reports 462 employees.

founded_year.notes: The co-founder’s origin story explicitly says the three founders established the company in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The public magazine and company-blog indexes contain accounting advice, product updates, customer stories, and company content. Technical-stack commentary and a CISO compliance article were found, but not two qualifying engineer-authored how-built posts.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is for Senior AI Systems Engineer in Melbourne.

model_provider.notes: Explicitly disclosed for Karbon AI; the cited disclosure does not establish the underlying model used by every newer Kai feature.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type II is certified; GDPR is a publicly claimed compliance status, not an independent certification. ISO 27001 is explicitly not independently certified; the PCI-DSS claim applies to Stripe, not Karbon.

last_funding.notes: The funding history identifies the latest round as Series B-II on September 18, 2023; the SEC filing reports the exact amount sold, versus the rounded $10.5 million shown in the funding history.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is September 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live posting is for Account Executive – Mid Market.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 6, 2026 announcement explicitly dates the launch of Kai, an AI coworker built into Karbon, to June 2026, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brooke Brockman joined as Chief Marketing Officer, announced November 11, 2025, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Account Executive posting requires updates in Salesforce/Gong, call analysis in Gong, and creating Outreach sequences.
